items.title: agent-desktop adds 2,470 stars as the computer-use race widens
items.summary:
vercel labs' rust cli lets agents drive desktop apps through their accessibility trees instead of guessing from screenshots.
it is at 15,398 stars and was pushed at 02:49 utc today, so the repo is still moving while it leads the daily chart.

items.title: nvidia's auto-ontology holds second at 2,050 stars today
items.summary:
the python framework builds a semantic graph layer over data so agents can generate queries that stay traceable.
it is at 5,370 stars, up about 1,100 since yesterday evening, and was pushed at 19:31 utc.

items.title: scrapling keeps 2,005 stars a day and is still being pushed
items.summary:
scrapling wraps a single request, a stealth browser and a full crawl behind one python api.
it is at 96,758 stars and had a commit at 20:30 utc, so the spike is not just a stale trend.

items.title: mattpocock's skills repo adds another 1,379 stars
items.summary:
it is a shell repo of agent skills pulled straight from the author's .agents directory.
it sits at 313,510 stars, one of the largest on the list, with no push since 11:45 utc yesterday.

items.title: claude-mem adds 1,172 stars for cross-session memory
items.summary:
it captures what an agent does, compresses it and injects the relevant parts into later sessions.
it is at 112,966 stars and was pushed at 02:03 utc today.

items.title: floci holds 1,090 stars for a free local aws emulator
items.summary:
floci is a java aws emulator that bills itself as the free local alternative.
it is at 29,710 stars and was pushed at 03:08 utc, minutes before this build.

items.title: worktrunk enters at 531 stars for parallel agent worktrees
items.summary:
it is a rust cli that manages git worktrees so several coding agents can work in parallel without collisions.
it added 531 stars today for 11,111 total and was pushed at 14:07 utc yesterday.

items.title: github's spec-kit adds 808 stars as spec-driven coding spreads
items.summary:
spec-kit is github's toolkit for writing a spec first and letting an agent build against it.
it is at 147,393 stars and was pushed at 22:34 utc yesterday.

items.title: democrats take congress and tehran calls it a vote against the war
items.summary:
trump accepted the result and said he can work with democrats, while ghalibaf said americans voted 'no to war'.
democrats flipped seven senate seats and nearly 30 house districts, giving them leverage over war funding.
items.change: trump moved from contesting the result to accepting it and offering to work with the new congress.

items.title: mojtaba khamenei says us hostility survives any election
items.summary:
iran's supreme leader dismissed the idea that a new congress changes anything and said us hostility toward iran will persist.
his first comment since the vote came as tehran rallies burned effigies of trump, vance and netanyahu.
items.change: the supreme leader's first response to the result, ruling out any policy shift from washington.

items.title: herzog accepts the result and opens coalition talks
items.summary:
israel's president accepted the certified results and began consultations, saying 'the elections are over, now is the time to face reality'.
the blocs stand at 53-48-19, so any government needs arab-led parties or a netanyahu-eisenkot deal.
items.change: consultations opened a day after the election committee rejected likud's fraud claims.

items.title: trump repeats the aid cut and a new democratic senator backs him
items.summary:
trump says the us will stop paying israel by the end of the year, and michigan's new senator abdul el-sayed agrees.
el-sayed wants a full ban rather than a cut, which gives the idea support in both parties.
items.change: a newly elected democratic senator came out for the cut, turning it from a trump line into a cross-party position.

items.title: south korea pushes its anti-piracy unit toward hormuz
items.summary:
seoul will ask parliament to extend the cheonghae unit's deployment and move it closer to the strait.
the unit's current mandate ends in december, and the shift comes as oil markets price a wider reopening.
items.change: the first new naval deployment announced since the tanker attacks began.

items.title: un warns lebanon could lose its buffer in december
items.summary:
the un's peacekeeping chief says lebanese and israeli forces could end up facing each other when unifil stops operating.
about 7,500 peacekeepers still serve with unifil, and lacroix said the liaison mechanism that clears aid convoys has no replacement.
items.change: the first explicit un warning about the security vacuum when unifil's operations end this year.

items.title: yemen's government says it took more ground in al-jawf and taiz
items.summary:
yemen's government says troops pushed further into the al-dahida mountain range in eastern al-jawf, a day after claiming the heights.
fighting also escalated in al-dhalea, lahij and taiz, and the casualty claims from both sides have no independent confirmation.
items.change: troops stormed houthi fortifications in al-dahida a day after the government claimed the range.

items.title: saudi signs $403m in development loans for syria
items.summary:
the saudi fund for development signed six concessional loans covering power, water, health, housing and digital projects.
$90m goes to aleppo's thermal plant and $30m to 300,000 smart water meters, signed with mbs and sharaa present.
items.change: a signed package with mbs and sharaa in the room, tying riyadh deeper to syria's reconstruction.

What next for Iran war after Trump's midterms defeat?

items.title: stocks surge as trump accepts the midterm result
items.summary:
the s&p 500 rose 1.58% to 7,688.62, the nasdaq 1.44% to 25,736.51 and the dow 3.03% to 53,356.12.
the vix fell 20.3% to 16.61 as the tail risk of a contested election came out of the price.

items.title: oil collapses as the war premium unwinds
items.summary:
wti fell 8.3% to settle at $88.12 and brent 8.7% to $94.62, with futures down more than 14% this week.
overnight wti slipped further to $87.04 while brent january traded at $93.90, with traders betting on a deal.

items.title: conocophillips and sony lead a heavy thursday earnings slate
items.summary:
conocophillips, sony, parker-hannifin, cummins, kimberly-clark and cigna report before the open.
airbnb, cloudflare, eog, monster and atlassian report after the close.

items.title: jobless claims and a bank of england decision fill thursday
items.summary:
us jobless claims are forecast at 196,000 with productivity at 2.8% and unit labour costs at 0.6%.
the bank of england decides at 15:00 riyadh and is expected to hold at 4.00%.

items.title: amdocs and fis lead the losers while rhythm jumps on a bid report
items.summary:
amdocs fell 30% on its worst day in 24 years over t-mobile business risk, and fis lost 23.7% after cutting guidance.
rhythm rose 28% on a report of a $10bn astrazeneca bid, and duolingo 26% on user growth.

items.title: data centre stocks crack as texas elects a moratorium governor
items.summary:
gina hinojosa won texas on a promise to halt new data centres, and investors marked down the power and neocloud complex.
vertiv fell 11.8%, ge vernova 11.3% and constellation 8%, with the neocloud etf down 6% and coreweave 7%.

items.title: the next debt ceiling fight is now the market's main political risk
items.summary:
democrats are preparing to use the debt limit to extract concessions from trump, and analysts expect a long standoff.
a miss on payments would hit treasury markets first, and the deficit is running at $1.99 trillion this year.

items.title: gold keeps climbing even as the election trade fades
items.summary:
gold futures were at $4,146.50, up 1.8%, while the 10-year yield fell to 4.894% from 4.952%.
it added to tuesday's 3% jump even as the vix fell back to 16.6, so the bid is not just an election hedge.

items.title: liverpool lose 3-2 in istanbul after leading twice
items.summary:
isak headed liverpool ahead for the second time on 69 minutes, then fenerbahce scored twice in a chaotic closing spell.
it is the latest liverpool have ever led in a major european game and lost, and their first champions league defeat of the season.

items.title: kuyt's interim spell produces a 'miracle' against his old club
items.summary:
dirk kuyt, the former liverpool winger, is fenerbahce's interim boss and said the comeback mentality came from liverpool.
he called it 'a miracle' and said not many expected fenerbahce to win after liverpool led twice.

items.title: gravenberch has a fractured heel and is out in istanbul
items.summary:
iraola said the midfielder has a heel fracture and was left at the axa centre, with sunday's trip to palace uncertain.
he felt it warming up against arsenal, and with palace on sunday the club chose not to risk the flight.

items.title: nyoni's new deal advances after another strong display
items.summary:
liverpool are close to an improved contract for trey nyoni after his first premier league start and a strong night in istanbul.
the 19-year-old was the one bright spot in the defeat, according to the echo's talking point.

items.title: bournemouth visit anfield in the carabao cup on 16 december
items.summary:
the quarter-final is set for wednesday 16 december at 20:00 gmt, shown on itv and sky in the uk.
it sits in a run of six games in 18 days, which is why rotation in istanbul matters more than usual.

items.title: chiesa's exit nears as heskey pushes liverpool on mora
items.summary:
the echo reports federico chiesa is moving towards the exit while talk of a trent alexander-arnold return grows.
emile heskey told liverpool to move for mexico's gilberto mora ahead of arsenal, a former-player opinion rather than a club move.

items.title: palace away is next on sunday at 17:00 riyadh
items.summary:
liverpool go to selhurst park on sunday 8 november for a 14:00 gmt kick-off.
after that, the next league game is manchester united at anfield on 22 november at 16:30.

items.title: wright's second youth hat-trick wins a 3-5 thriller
items.summary:
will wright scored three as liverpool's u19s beat fenerbahce 5-3 in the youth league in istanbul.
it was his second hat-trick in the competition and came in a game that also had a red card.
